Certificam faptul ca preparatele noastre sunt corect executate respectandu-se cu strictete normele de igiena si legislatia in vigoare si nu in utimul rand normele morale vis-a-vis de semenii nostri. Mentionam faptul ca unitatea noastra detine toate avizele necesare desfasurasurarii activitatii de productie si livrare. Deoarece normele morale, sunt foarte importante pentru noi, respectam principiile alimentare sanatoase si de aceea preparatele culinare nu contin coloranti, aditivi sau conservanti iar retetele cuprind ingrediente traditionale, eliminati fiind potetiatorii de arome. Ne ingrijim de calitate preparatelor culinare si a serviciilor noastre chiar si dupa inchiderea procesului de gatire. normalized.description: There is currently a limited understanding of the cloud feedbacks and precipitation in climate models and numerical weather predictions, which is a major source of uncertainty. To reduce this uncertainty, a better characterization of cloud and precipitation vertical structure is required. A solution consists of combining measurements from multi-frequency radars with frequencies ranging from 10 GHz to above 200 GHz. Therefore, inclusion of G-band would be highly beneficial for retrieval of several new scientific products. The G-band radar will require a high transmitted power. The 238 GHz solid-state power amplifier has been identified as key risk areafor which early technology assessment needs to be undertaken. The activity aims to develop and test a breadboard of a solid-state power amplifier at 238 GHz based on state-of-the-art technologies providing 250 mW of saturated output power.
